name: I-acne
tagline: Iyanyangeka. Musa ukukhetha. Bonana nogqirha ukuze ufumane unyango olufanelekileyo.

what_is_it.heading: I-acne ngamazwi alula
what_is_it.lede: I-acne yinto eyenzekayo xa ioli kunye neeseli zesikhumba ezifileyo zivala iipores. Ngamanye amaxesha i-pore evaliweyo ivuvukala yintsholongwane yesiqhelo yolusu - kulapho ufumana amabala abomvu, abuhlungu. Ayibangelwa kukungcola.
paragraphs: I-acne ixhaphake kakhulu kulutsha ngenxa yokuba utshintsho lwamahomoni lunyusa imveliso yeoli. Kodwa abantu abadala nabo bayayifumana - ngakumbi abafazi abakwiminyaka yabo yama-20 kunye nama-30, rhoqo ecaleni komhlathi. Malunga nama-85% abemi boMzantsi Afrika baya kuba namaqhakuva ngaxa lithile.

I-acne ethambileyo idla ngokuphendula kunyango lwe-ngaphandle kwegqirha kunye nemikhwa elungileyo yolusu. Amaqhakuva aphakathi ukuya kobukhali - ngakumbi ngamaqhakuva, amanxeba, okanye iintlungu - ifuna ugqirha. Unyango olusebenzayo lwamayeza lukhona. I-acne enganyangwayo inokushiya amanxeba asisigxina kwaye ichaphazele ukuzithemba iminyaka.

items.body: Kubemi boMzantsi Afrika bafumana amaqhakuva ngaxa lithile. Yenye yezona meko zixhaphakileyo zolusu ehlabathini.

items.headline: Iyanyangeka
items.body: Nokuba i-acne enzima iphendula kunyango lwanamhlanje. Okukhona uqala kwangethuba, kokukhona kuncipha ukonakala kuya kufuneka uhlale naso.

items.headline: Musa ukukhetha
items.body: Ukukha, ukukhama, kunye nokukhuhla rhabaxa kwenza amaqhakuva abe mandundu kwaye abangele amanxeba angapheliyo. Umkhwa onzima wokuqhawula - kwaye eyona nto ibalulekileyo.

items.headline: Ayilotyala lakho
items.body: I-acne ayibangelwa kukungcola, ukutya itshokolethi, okanye nantoni na oyenzileyo. Ubukhulu becala ngamahomoni kunye nemfuzo.

pull_quote.text: Elona nyathelo linamandla lokunyanga amaqhakuva kukuqala kwangethuba - phambi kokuba kuqalise ukonakala. Ukuba unyango olufumaneka ngaphandle kwekhawuntara alusebenzi emva kweeveki ezisi-8, bonana nogqirha.

signs.heading: Iintlobo ze-acne - kwaye zinzulu kangakanani
signs.lede: I-acne iqala kwiindawo ezimbalwa ukuya kwi-cysts enzulu, ebuhlungu. Uhlobo lubalulekile kuba lutshintsha unyango.

items.title: Mild - blackheads kunye whiteheads
items.description: Amaqhuma amancinci ngaphandle kokuvuvukala okuninzi. Ngokuqhelekileyo iphendula ngokunakekela ulusu elungileyo kunye neemveliso ze-ngaphandle kwegqirha. Zama i-benzoyl peroxide okanye i-salicylic acid kuqala.

items.title: Imodareyitha - ebomvu, amabala avuthayo
items.description: Iipapule ezibomvu kunye neepustules ebusweni, isifuba, umqolo. Zama unyango lwe-ngaphandle kwegqirha kwiiveki ezisi-8. Ukuba akukho phuculo - bonana nogqirha. Iinketho zamayeza zisebenza ngcono.

items.title: Emandundu - cysts kunye scarring
items.description: Amaqhuma anzulu, abuhlungu ahlala iiveki. Ushiya amanxeba. Bona ugqirha ngokukhawuleza. I-Isotretinoin (i-Roaccutane) isebenza kakhulu kule nto.

items.myth: Itshokholethi, ukutya okunamafutha, kunye neswekile kubangela amaqhakuva.
items.fact: Ubungqina bubuthathaka kwaye buhluka phakathi kwabantu. Ukutya okuneswekile eninzi/ubisi oluphezulu kunokuwenza mandundu amaqhakuva kwezinye, kodwa akubangeli oko. IiHormones kunye ne-genetics zibaluleke kakhulu.

items.myth: Hlamba ubuso bakho ngakumbi - oko kuya kulungisa.
items.fact: Ukuhlamba kakhulu kuyayomisa kwaye kuyacaphukisa ulusu, okwenza amaqhakuva abe mandundu. Isicoci esithambileyo kabini ngemini kwanele. Izikhuhla ezirhabaxa zitshisa ulusu kwaye zibebomvu kakhulu.

items.myth: Intlama yamazinyo, ijusi yelamuni, kunye nebicarb zisebenza njengonyango lwasekhaya.
items.fact: Zonke zinokulucaphukisa okanye lutshise ulusu kwaye lube mandundu ukonakala. Sebenzisa iimveliso ezifanelekileyo ze-acne - i-benzoyl peroxide, i-salicylic acid, i-retinoids - eyenzelwe ukusebenza ngokukhuselekileyo.
Ukwaluka kunokomisa ulusu okwethutyana, okwenza amabala angabonakali. Ixesha elide, umonakalo welanga ubangela ukonakala kwaye udala ulusu lwakho. Nyanga i-acne - khusela ulusu lwakho.

prevention.heading: Imikhwa yemihla ngemihla eluncedo
prevention.lede: Awukwazi ukukhusela ngokupheleleyo i-acne - kodwa unokunciphisa ukuvutha, ukuxhasa unyango, kunye nokukhusela izibazi.

items.title: Isicoci esithambileyo kabini ngosuku
items.description: Ekuseni nangokuhlwa - esekelwe emanzini, engenavumba. Musa ukukhuhla. Musa ukusebenzisa isepha yebha okanye izikhuhla ezirhabaxa kwisikhumba esine-acne.

items.title: I-SPF engekho-comedogenic yonke imihla
items.description: Ukhuseleko lwelanga lubalulekile nakwi-acne. Jonga i-'non-comedogenic' (ayiyi kuvala iipores) kwileyibhile. Uninzi lweempawu eziphambili zinezi.

items.title: Musa ukukhetha - musa ukucudisa
items.description: Ukuchola kulutyhalela ngakumbi usulelo kwaye kuguqula amabala abe ziva. Uphawu olusuka kwindawo ekhethiweyo lunokuhlala iinyanga ezi-6. Uphawu olusuka kwindawo esekhohlo-kodwa-mhlawumbi iiveki ezi-2.

items.title: Nika unyango iiveki ezisi-8
items.description: Unyango lwe-acne luthatha iiveki ezi-6-12 ukubonisa isiphumo esipheleleyo. Musa ukutshintsha rhoqo emva kweentsuku ezimbalwa. Qhubeka nendlela enye kwaye ugwebe ngamanqaku eeveki ezisi-8.

items.title: Qala nge-ngaphandle kwegqirha ye-acne ephakathi
items.description: Benzoyl peroxide 2.5% gel okanye salicylic acid ukuhlamba. Sebenzisa kanye ngosuku ngeveki, emva koko kabini ukuba ukunyamezela. Ifumaneka kuyo nayiphi na ikhemesti ngaphandle kwencwadi kagqirha.

items.title: Ukuba akukho phuculo emva kweeveki ezi-8 - bonana nogqirha
items.description: Isimahla kuyo nayiphi na ikliniki karhulumente. I-retinoids ye-topical retinoids kunye ne-antibiotics isebenza ngcono kakhulu kune-OTC ye-acne ephakathi.

items.title: Ukuba kubi kakhulu okanye kukho amanxeba - bona kungekudala
items.description: I-cystic acne enzima inokushiya amanxeba asisigxina. Unyango olufana ne-isotretinoin (i-Roaccutane) lusebenza kakhulu. Iiklinikhi zikarhulumente zinokubhekisa kugqirha wesikhumba.

items.title: Phatha yonke indawo, hayi amabala kuphela
items.description: Faka unyango kancinci kwindawo echaphazelekayo - hayi nje kwiindawo ezizimeleyo. Inqanda ukuqhawuka okulandelayo endaweni yokubamba.

items.title: Khusela ulusu lwakho elangeni
items.description: Unyango lwe-acne lwenza ulusu lube nelanga. Sebenzisa non-comedogenic SPF 30+ yonke imihla. Ilanga kwakhona lenza mandundu amanqaku amnyama ashiywe ngamabala adlulileyo.

get_help.heading: Masiye phi
get_help.lede: Uninzi lwamaqhakuva lunokunyangwa ekhaya okanye kwikliniki yokhathalelo lokuqala. Izibonelelo ezibukhali ze-acne ekugqithisweni kwe-dermatology-ifumaneka ngenkqubo yoluntu.

helplines.name: Fumana eyona kliniki ikufutshane nawe
helplines.description: Uvavanyo lwe-acne lwamahhala kunye nonyango lonyango
helplines.meta: Akukho kuqeshwa · akukho ncedo lwezonyango olufunekayo

helplines.name: Nayiphi na ikhemesti yendawo
helplines.description: Kwi-ngaphandle kwegqirha benzoyl peroxide, i-salicylic acid, iikhrimu ze-retinoid
